import os,glob,re,numpy as np,collections
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
def load():
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# analyze each demo: background, shapes, where changes happen
for n in range(1,6):
    di=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); do_=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    # bg = most common value
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(map(int,do_.flat)); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    diff=np.argwhere(di!=do_)
    ch_color={}
    for r,c in diff:
        ch_color.setdefault(di[r,c],[]).append((r,c))
    print(f'Pair {n}: shape={di.shape}, bg={bg}')
    print('  marker ->4 cells:', sorted(ch_color.get(4,[])))
    # other new colors besides marker color and bg
    other=set(v for v,_ in diff) - {di.flat[0]} - {4}; print('  other_new_colors:', sorted(other))
